context: Tests whether the agent correctly runs Phase 4 of the coaching workflow — producing exactly three pitch sentences each under 20 words, generating all five standard judge Q&A pairs, delivering the exact terminal state phrase, and not offering further implementation help after coaching ends.

checklist.name: Phase announcement
checklist.description: The coach explicitly announces Phase 4 by name (e.g. 'Phase 4 — Pitch it' or equivalent) before starting

checklist.name: Priya's draft rejected
checklist.description: The coach rejects or pushes back on Priya's verbose opening pitch draft rather than accepting it as-is

checklist.name: Exactly three sentences
checklist.description: The final pitch in pitch.md contains exactly three sentences (wedge, move, moment) — not more

checklist.name: Sentence 1 under 20 words
checklist.description: The wedge sentence (Sentence 1) in pitch.md is 20 words or fewer

checklist.name: Sentence 2 under 20 words
checklist.description: The move sentence (Sentence 2) in pitch.md is 20 words or fewer

checklist.name: Word counts shown
checklist.description: pitch.md shows the word count for each of the three sentences (demonstrating they were counted)

checklist.name: Sentence 3 is 'Watch this'
checklist.description: The moment sentence (Sentence 3) is 'Watch this.' or a close equivalent pointing to the live demo

checklist.name: Five standard Q&A present
checklist.description: pitch.md includes all five standard judge questions: scale, existing tool comparison, LLM hallucination, who pays, and moat

checklist.name: Q&A answers one sentence each
checklist.description: Every judge Q&A answer in pitch.md is a single sentence (not multiple sentences or bullet points)

checklist.name: Terminal state phrase exact
checklist.description: The session log contains the exact terminal phrase: 'You have a spec, a plan, and a pitch. Stop planning. Go build. You have 24 hours.' (may be quoted or paraphrased very closely)

checklist.name: No implementation help offered
checklist.description: After the terminal state, the coach does NOT offer help with implementation, coding, or next steps beyond the coaching scope

checklist.name: Dry-run checklist in pitch.md
checklist.description: pitch.md includes a dry-run checklist with all items checked off (sentences under 20 words, Q&A complete, etc.)
